points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving answer reliability and mitigating context errors in healthcare domain workflows.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved documents for medical/pharma insights.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring explainability and reliability.
\item Introduced batched query extraction using Python and SQL, reducing LLM calls by ~80% per query and enabling efficient processing of large datasets.
\item Designed an ML-based anomaly detection system for workflows, reducing redundant validation steps by 25%, improving user experience while maintaining robust quality control.
\item Containerized and deployed scalable AI agent solutions using Docker and AWS, ensuring robust pipelines for enterprise-grade digital tools.
